lines.pa1: Parity checking counts the number of one bits in a byte. The parity is either even, or odd.
lines.pa2: One bit, usually the left most, is reserved as the parity bit. For even parity, it is set so the total number of ones is even.
lines.pa3: Four ones is already even, so the parity bit is zero. With three ones, the parity bit must be one.
lines.bk1: A parity block adds a parity byte after a block of bytes. Every column gets a parity bit too.
lines.bk2: If one bit flips, one row and one column fail. The wrong bit sits where they cross, so it can be corrected.
lines.outro: A parity bit for each byte, a parity byte for each block. Errors found, and even fixed.
